Why QA Breaks

Let me guess: your devs are testing their own code. The offshore team is checking boxes but missing critical bugs. You ship, users complain, and everyone scrambles. Sound familiar?

Developer blindness

"It works perfectly!" (Narrator: it didn't)

Checkbox Circus

1000 test cases passed, but users still hate it

Shifting QA Left Out

"QA? We’ll add it later." (Result: bugs made in from day one)

Last-minute panic

"Can you test this before tomorrow's release?"

Tool Addiction

$100K spent on tools, still shipping bugs

Missing Owner

No clear QA accountability → everyone assumes “someone else” tested it.
